intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Senna is restocking her apron. Every vial has a label. So does the ball of twine. It says *TWINE*.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Then she takes out a small jar with a wax-sealed cork. Its label says *DO NOT*.

options.labelText: “Should that really live in your apron? I’ll find it a safe shelf.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “It lives in the apron because the apron is always with me.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The jar goes into a pocket labeled *DEFINITELY DO NOT*. She buttons it.

options.labelText: “What’s in it? I’ll stand over here while you tell me.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Rosary peas. *Abrus precatorius*. Bright red, with one black dot, like a ladybug keeping a secret.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Someone was selling them strung as bracelets. Fine on a wrist. Chew one and you’d be very ill for a very long time.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She tilts the jar to show you the bottom. There’s a second label. It says *REALLY*.
